Check CCT's FYE 9/2026 990 Part VII-B and Schedule O, CCT job postings and RFPs, the portal docs on donorportal.cct.org, and any Give or GiftingNetwork release naming CCT

question: Who received Fidelity Charitable's 'significant outlier granting totaling $727 million' in CY2025 (2026 Giving Report), and was it DAF-to-DAF?
